Trace, implement and test: leetcode4 median of two sorted arrays

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    double findMedianSortedArrays(vector<int>& nums1, vector<int>& nums2) {
        vector<int> nums;         
        double res;
        int m = nums1.size();
        int n = nums2.size();
        int len;

        int i = 0, j = 0;
        while (i < m && j < n)  // 只要一个指针扫到数组末尾，循环结束
        {
            if(nums1[i] <= nums2[j])
            {
                nums.push_back(nums1[i]);
                i++;
            }
            else {
                nums.push_back(nums2[j]);
                j++;
            }
        }

        while(i < m)  // 数组nums1没跑完，nums2已跑完时
        {
            nums.push_back(nums1[i]);
            i++;
        }

        while(j < n)  // 数组nums2没跑完，nums1已跑完时
        {
            nums.push_back(nums2[j]);
            j++;
        }
        len = nums.size();
        if(len % 2 == 0)
        {
            res = (nums[len/2] + nums[len/2-1])/2.0;
        }
        else res = nums[len/2];

        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums1 = {1,3};
    vector<int> nums2 = {0,2,5};
    double res = sol.findMedianSortedArrays(nums1, nums2);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
